public_rationale: July brought declines in several AI-linked stocks, while AI companies continued attracting substantial investment. Neither record directly measures a broad GenAI financing and valuation reversal. The evidence therefore does not settle whether a bubble had begun bursting under the ordinary market-wide reading.
limitations: A narrower claim about a technology-stock correction would be easier to support.
Continued fundraising does not itself prove valuations were justified or exclude weakness elsewhere.
Later market performance is not substituted for the July observation.
